notes.title: New GamePlay
notes.content:
Hi everyone

Have a look at this video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tJq83vvWB60&feature=youtu.be

All units now have a Health bar and a Food bar. If a unit is missing health, they get get food from a unit an part of the food becomes health.

if a unit is missing food, they go take it from a replete ant or the queen. A unit cannot work if it has 0 food.

The game can be speed up 3 times.
Saving/loading is 100% done
Tutorial has 7 parts so far

I bought the sounds and i'm working on the Music Manager
next build should have the sounds


The game still has a bug here or there, but it's playable! Most of the bugs a specific situations like, the player jumps over the fence if he climbs rocks and trees.

Alpha testers are killing, by the way!!! They are really helpful


Cheers

notes.title: Alpha has Started
notes.content:
Alpha has launched and the feedback is very positive!

I'm having a really good time exchanging and communicating with testers.

So far, I got people I know trying out the game. At Some moment I will switch to beta and invite more players. Players who are helping me out are going to have their names in the credits.

The game keeps growing! I'm implementing a lot of new ideas and past suggestions in the game.

THINGS LIKE:

 - Units now have a health bar AND a food bar. In nature ants store food in their abdomen that they can after share with other ants that are in need. When a worker brings back food to the colony, he finds a replete or the queen and gives the food in the storing ant. This food is later use to get health back or use to feed the eggs and larva.

- The player can only see his colony when underground. I added a very nice fog that matches the underground that prevents form seeing to infinity. The player can also only zoom out as far as he as dug + a reasonable player distance.

- The player can start Quests! There's a Panel that allows to start different quests. Things like : Summon 3 spiders and kill them in 3 minutes,  Or : prevent all beetles from reaching the other side. Funs stuff!!

- A very descriptive Tutorial allowing new players to fully grasp everything that can be done. It's a step by step tutorial with unlockable zones.

WORK IN PROGRESS
- balance units
- balance the economy
- 90 % of saving/loading has been completed. Not certain of i will allow eggs to be saved, because of cheating.
- Sound and music is at 0%. Im still looking for a good soundtrack, unit and ambient sounds have been found and they sound very good.

Thank you

notes.title: Second Month of Work
notes.content:
https://fernandodudka.wixsite.com/antqueen3d

This Month,

I did a lot of work this Month... on stop of being tremendously good looking!! 

The game is now network ready, two players can build their colony and each ant created is not controllable by the opposing player. I made sure to make it secure. Basically preventing any weird person from trying to control non-authorited game object.

Digging is also replicated on both sides. When a Dig action has been commanded, some ground "blocks" are created and the players needs to clean his colony if he wants to dig further in the direction. The player needs to first set a zone where he would like ants to drop dirt blocks and the "Cleaning " will start. 

(Player needs to in FPS view to dig his colony.).
At the moment ants don't dig alone, player needs to expand his colony and workers will come "Clean".
I programmed the ground blocks to be controllable only by the player who dug them also. I think that it could cause game logic issues if any player can contro digging dirt blocks form opposing nest in an advance game.


You can have a look at the FPS view and at the RTS view int the pictures.

I also replaced the dummy ants i was using with some ants i found. These are unofficial, it's to show everyone what it would look like.


Thank you
Leave a comment or message me if you have any suggestion.

notes.title: Dev Blog
notes.content:
I created a blog to show the progress of the game

https://fernandodudka.wixsite.com/antqueen3d

so far...
Player starts with a queen in First person view, than you decide where you want your colony and you dig a first tunnel. 

Once you decided what will be the first room, you can start creating workers

Worked automatically start to create a pheromone map.

If pheromones are near each other and nothing is between them ( "wall" ), they become linked. This is done recursively, unlinked pheromone can become linked at any time a new pheromone is being linked near by.

Workers follow a path or if they reach the end, they start adding pheromones on the map.

If a line of linked pheromone touch a food source, the linked pheromone line become green.

If a line of pheromone is green, ants will follow that line until they reach a good source 

Worked after bring back food parts to the queen to feed her

Once food pile is empty, the pheromone link becomes grey again.

🙀

notes.title: Ant Queen 3D is on the move 🙀
notes.content:
I'm happy to let you all know that I'm working on the new version of ant queen!!!

So far,
-It's going to be in full 3D! I might have found a 3D artist that will make 3D ants.
I'm thinking of having 3 different type of ants. ( not certain what ants it's going to be)

-I'm working on a 3D voxel terrain where the players can actually dig their colony. Like mine craft but not blocks, it's really terrain morphing. Pathfinding is hard but I'm getting there.

-It's a network multiplayer game 1vs1, but it could be maybe be 2vs2. First 1vs1!

-The game style will be a mix between RTS top view and a FPS. You will actually take control of an ant and walk in the map or control many units from top view.

-There will be a pheromone system. Exemple, after having kill a spider, you will take control of an ant and place a pheromone trail for the colony to the food. Once a link is created, ants will start to follow the path and move towards the food source

If you have any ideas you think are awesome, get in touch or post right here!

Thank you

notes.title: Ant Queen Futur - Multiplayer
notes.content:
Dear players,
 I would like to let you all know that i'm presently learning the magic of Multiplayer video gaming. A big demand from players was to have a multiplayer mode where you can play agains other players!

This last 3 months i have been working, learning the multiplayer platform and making a new game. The reason for the update break of Ant Queen. I really had to take a break from working on this projet.

Making an RTS game is THE most difficult game to programme and making an Online Multiplayer RTS is just programming set to God Mode. I'm planning on finishing the game i'm working on - Aetherios - and after that Restart from scratch Ant Queen ( 3D ) and having it be a  solid multiplayer game.

For now, I invite you all to come have a peek at my new project.

http://aetherios.live/

I'm also looking for a pool of players who would like to take part in the Alpha and Beta phase of the Aetherios development, cause I learned that i really need to this!!
Send me a private message with your email where i can send you a build.

Thank you
Invantage

notes.title: Patch 3.3
notes.content:
Hi all!!

this saturday I was a the MIGF ( Montrel Independent Game Festival ) and it was so much fun! A lot of people showed up, I had a stand to let people try out the game and they jsut loved it! Some people actually voted Ant Queen as their favorite!!!

So thank you again for the great support. All of this is possible thanks to all the players that keep helping me to fix and upgrade the game.

About this patch 3.3

Story Mode :
 - The Queen should stop moving in randomize destinations
 - Level 1 - The collider that makes the game succesfull was too small. It will   detect more easily when the queen reaches the hole.
 - Level 2 - The Path finding was too precise and some ants where getting stuck in the inside colony. Should not happen anymore
 - Level 19 - The Ui Icon to get outside the  red ant colony were acting weird... replaced them with what the should be.

Unlimited / Sandbox:
 - Queen starts with 100Hp in easy, 80 in Medium,50 in hard
 - Easy mode is easier. Red ants spawning rate is slower and they do less damage
 
Thanks again and let me know i f you see something

Next patch
- fix the achivement system fixed
- Unlimited NPC spawn rate nerf

notes.title: Patch 2.7 - Green Ants galore
notes.content:
Hi community and players,

We are continuing our frequent updates and giving a player a wish : a more costly but yet more powerful ant type - the green ants !

Also, we did crushed some bugs, as appropriate for ants masterz, and made minor adjustments to both the story mode and the sandbox :
- blue, red and yellow ants are 25% more expensive
- green ants are an additional 25% compared to other ants
- we added a UI cue for ants' costs
- the new patrol system is now also available in story mode
- workers use less CPU and memory while doing the same job (good efficient workers is what a Queen likes !)
- achievements have been added for the green ants
- music has been added for the sandbox mode

TODO : 
- add survival mode to the sandbox (with scoring)
- balance green ants compared to the rest

REQUEST TO PLAYERS : a player has noticed a crash at the end of level 15 in story mode that would be due to garbage collection (GC error message) :
- we would appreciate any player encountering it sending a PM or a comment here 
- any player that would feel like testing it, we would love to get feedback if it happens to you

We hope you continue enjoy the game, do not hesitate to post comment and suggestions as usual !

notes.title: Patch 2.6
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

SandBox:
 - In this patch, we added the option for the players to set patrol points rather than having the ants patrol between the nest and foraging zones. 
 - the player can click on a new UI flag button and after click on the ground to set an orange flag. Soldiers and Super Soldiers will patrol between does points and the colony.
 - Flags cannot be set on water, rocks or on the players nest.
 - the player can delete all patrol flags with a UI button.
 - When red ants go inside the colony, the player's ants that are insided the colony will rush to defend from the intruders. The queen will be the last one to die.
- If the player has no more nursers, the first nursers can become mature on it's own.
- There is always atleast one RedAnt Nurser.
- Red ants that are in their colony, are harder to kill and do more damage
- Made a mix of the songs to not have the same song on loop

StoryMode
 - fixed level 10 victory condition. Sorry...

This Working on
 - Adding a 5th type of ant, the green ants. These ants will be more expansive and overall better than other ants.
 - Add a box for the mini-map
 - Add a second Red Ant Colony in the Hard Sandbox mode
 - Add a survival mode in the sandbox
 - Add achivements for the sandbox

Thank you again for all of your input
inVantage

notes.title: SandBox is live!
notes.content:
Ant Queen  has been improved a lot!

I received a lot of feedback from many players who wanted to improve the game and I just added all of them in the game!

The SandBox mode has been added in the game!
Every new game, the map is generated randomly and once you save your progress, you can  reload  and keep building your colony. 
The sandbox can be set to Easy-Medium-hard

The UI interface and the controls  have been modified
The task controls are accurate 
You can selected different groups of ants by colours 
You can kill your own units

I added a voxel  terrain for the underground colony
Player has more freedom to build his colony as we wishes!
You can allow the diggers to dig automatiy or not 
You can clear your digging paths 

AI has been improved 
NPC's interact with each other's
Red ant Ai is more aggressive
Each class of ants behaves  differently 


You can point out any other ideas you have 

Cheers
InVantage

Every new game, the map is generated randomly and once you save your progress, you can  reload  and keep building your colony. 
The sandbox can be set to Easy-Medium-hard

The UI interface and the controls  have been modified
The task controls are accurate 
You can selected different groups of ants by colours 
You can kill your own units

I added a voxel  terrain for the underground colony
Player has more freedom to build his colony as we wishes!
You can allow the diggers to dig automatiy or not 
You can clear your digging paths 

AI has been improved 
NPC's interact with each other's
Red ant Ai is more aggressive
Each class of ants behaves  differently 


You can point out any other ideas you have 

Cheers
InVantage

notes.title: SandBox progress
notes.content:
Hello fellow players,
 
SandBox mode is being worked on and it's so much fun!!!

So far :
 - The map is new every time you start a new Game.
 - You can save your game - load and all rocks,plants,vines,etc. are recored and stay at the same place when you load your saved game.
 - If you start a new game and save, the old game is "deleted";
 - At the beginning of a new level, you start with the queen only and you have a new Icon, the colony Icon, you click on it and with you mouse you can place it on the map. This will place your colony where you want it.
 - The colony position is also saved and the random red ant colony position is also saved (if you save...).
 - once you are inside your colony, you have the option to lay eggs and the first nurser you will spawn will develop automatically to adult, it can be a black,yellow,red or blue nurser. 

Working on:
 - the new digging system where you can dig your own tunnels and set what the food,egg,larva,cocoon chambers positons will be.
 - the NPC spawning. This will be easy since it's already made. Just need to chose what NPC to spawn.
 -The max ants you will be able to spawn. Since the map is humongous. We need to test out what a low end computer can support. 

Since this is becoming more of a community project. I would like to hear your ideas. Now's the time to add things you think will make the gameplay better!

Thank you
Invantage

notes.title: Bug fixing and price adjustment
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
First we would to thank you for your feedbacks. We will work on improving the game to make it better.

We fixed a new price and as a gift we will send a package of additional levels to the players who already own the game. 

We are not making excuses, but we hope you understand that it's always difficult to know if 2 years of your life are worth 17$ or 11$, or none.

Also, we carefully chose the word 'simulation' and not strategy because our vision for the game was of being like a real ant queen in nature, not so much like an omniscient goddess. Far from entering the 'Elite: Dangerous / Star Citizen' debate, we've chosen a more relaxed or laid back approach where you can watch your colony grow without controling each and every ant decision (which you still can btw, it s just very involving...). This is no Starcraft, this is no RTS. Maybe we should have stated it right away in those words.
We will make sure that the description makes it clear before you buy it.

We hope we can work with everybody that has problems to fix them, for the rest, if you want a strategy game, I'm sure you will find many on Steam...
